title: A face with eyes
goals: Eyes: lids cut along their edges, a globe with iris and cornea, lashes, brows
The head laid out anew from measures: a forehead, a nose, two lips, a chin, a jaw
The tool draws five face views and prints fourteen face measures
The body as it was: one closed skin, the same measures, the same poses
Seen in the library on a real GPU, and timed
Photoreal: ears, hair, skin that differs from place to place, a face that moves

clips.name: The meadow, one tent

clips.name: Towards the tent

captions.text: A face where there was a mask
Ok eyes and face is the worst at the moment
the body is okay for now
Its eyes were two balls looking out of holes.
Now a lid's edge is cut pixel by pixel, over a globe with an iris.
With eyes in it, the head was still a mask.
Its mouth lay 8 mm under its own teeth.
So I laid the head out anew, level by level,
from its skull and the measured face of a man.
Its neck measured 43 cm round. Now 39.4.
A face, yes. A photograph, no: the ears, the hair, a blink.
Seen on a software GPU only. Not yet in the library.
